from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b0439026.py')

code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    def reflect(i):
        q, r = divmod(i, n)
        return r if q % 2 else n - 1 - r
    return [[grid[reflect(i)][reflect(j)] for j in range(3*n)] for i in range(3*n)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
grid=[[8,8,6],[6,3,6],[6,8,8]]
